      if (sessionStoreId != null && !isNaN(sessionStoreId)) {
        return parseInt(String(sessionStoreId), 10);
      }
      var localUserStoreNumber = ldReadUserStoreNumberFromLocalPreferred();
      if (localUserStoreNumber != null && !isNaN(localUserStoreNumber)) {
        return localUserStoreNumber;
      }
      var preferredStore = ldReadPreferredStoreDataFromLocalStorage();
      var localGuestStoreNumber = ldParseStoreNumber(
        preferredStore && preferredStore.guestStore && preferredStore.guestStore.storeNumber
      );
      if (localGuestStoreNumber != null && !isNaN(localGuestStoreNumber)) {
        return localGuestStoreNumber;
      }
      var cachedStoreId = ldGigyaCtx().storeId;
      if (typeof cachedStoreId === 'string' && cachedStoreId.trim() && /^\d+$/.test(cachedStoreId.trim())) {
        return parseInt(cachedStoreId.trim(), 10);
      }
      return null;
    }

    function ldDispatchIdentifyComplete() {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dg:ldIdentifyComplete'));
    }

    function ldIdentifyPromiseCatch(result) {
      var onDone = function () {
        ldMaybeCompleteBootstrap();
        ldDispatchIdentifyComplete();
      };
      if (result != null && typeof result.then === 'function') {
        result.then(onDone).catch(function (err) {
          console.error('[LD] identify failed', err);
          onDone();
        });
      } else {
        onDone();
      }
    }

    function ldIdentifyUser(sessionData) {
      var client = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.ldClient;
      if (!client) {
        return;
      }
      try {
        var isAuthenticated = sessionData && sessionData.sessionType === 'authenticated';
        var context = isAuthenticated
          ? ldAuthenticatedLdContext(sessionData)
          : ldGuestLdContext(sessionData);
        ldEnrichLdUserContext(context, sessionData, isAuthenticated);
        globalThis.DG = globalThis.DG || {};
        var identifyKey = ldCtxKey(context);
        if (identifyKey && globalThis.DG.ldIdentifyKey === identifyKey) {
          ldMaybeCompleteBootstrap();
          ldDispatchIdentifyComplete();
          return;
        }
        globalThis.DG.ldIdentifyKey = identifyKey;
        ldIdentifyPromiseCatch(client.identify(context));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[LD] identify failed', e);
        ldMaybeCompleteBootstrap();
        ldDispatchIdentifyComplete();
      }
    }

    initLaunchDarkly();

    window.addEventListener('updateStoreEvent', function () {
      var sessionData = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData;
      if (!sessionData) {
        return;
      }
      ldSeedContextFromSessionAndLocal(sessionData);
      ldIdentifyUser(sessionData);
    });

    /**
     * Store service enum in binary for "sezzle" is {@code 1000 0000 0000 0000 0000}.
     */
    const SEZZLE_BIT_MASK_VALUE = 524288;

    /**
     * Store service enum in binary for "bopis" is {@code 0000 0000 0000 0000 1000}.
     */
    const BOPIS_BIT_MASK_VALUE = 8;

    /**
     * Store service enum in binary for "delivery" is {@code 0000 0000 0001 0000 0000}.
     */
    const DELIVERY_BIT_MASK_VALUE = 256;

    /**
     * The key name for the object stored in localStorage for user store and guest store data.
     */
    const PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY = "preferredStoreData";

    function ldParseStoreNumber(storeNumber) {
      if (storeNumber == null) {
        return null;
      }
      var parsed = parseInt(String(storeNumber), 10);
      return isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed;
    }

    function ldReadPreferredStoreDataFromLocalStorage() {
      try {
        var storedJson = localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);
        if (!storedJson) {
          return null;
        }
        return JSON.parse(storedJson);
      } catch (ignored) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    const DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER = 1014;
    const DEFAULT_STORE_SEARCH_RADIUS = 10;
    const DEFAULT_LATITUDE = 0;
    const DEFAULT_LONGITUDE = 0;

    const useCloudService = window.__FEATURE_FLAGS__?.useCloudServicesHeader;
    const enableStoreSelectionFromURL = window.__FEATURE_FLAGS__?.enableStoreSelectionFromURL;

    const isSezzle = (storeService) =>
      (storeService & SEZZLE_BIT_MASK_VALUE) === SEZZLE_BIT_MASK_VALUE;
    const isBopis = (storeService) =>
      (storeService & BOPIS_BIT_MASK_VALUE) === BOPIS_BIT_MASK_VALUE;
    const isDelivery = (storeService) =>
      (storeService & DELIVERY_BIT_MASK_VALUE) === DELIVERY_BIT_MASK_VALUE;

    function getPreferredStoreDetails() {
      return localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);
    }

    /**
     * Reads a token value from the session data populated by /bin/dg/user.
     * Replaces the old getCookie()-based token reads.
     */
    function getToken(key) {
      return globalThis.DG?.sessionData?.[key] || '';
    }

    function getCookie(cname) {
      let name = cname + "=";
      let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
      let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
      for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
        let c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
          c = c.substring(1);
        }
        if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
          return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
        }
      }
      return "";
    }

    /**
     * Runs a callback once the Gigya browser SDK is ready without overwriting
     * other ready handlers registered elsewhere in the page.
     */
    function runWhenGigyaReady(callback) {
      if (window.gigya?.isReady) {
        callback();
        return;
      }

      const previousReadyHandler = window.onGigyaServiceReady;
      window.onGigyaServiceReady = (...args) => {
        if (typeof previousReadyHandler === 'function') {
          previousReadyHandler(...args);
        }
        callback();
      };
    }

    function getQueryParam(param) {
      try {
        const val = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get(param);
        return val ? parseInt(val, 10) : null;
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    /**
     * Writes store details into localStorage.
     * Store API returns abbreviated keys (sn, ad, ct, st, zp, la, lo, ss).
     */
    function setStoreDetails(storeObj, isUser) {
      if (!storeObj?.sn || !storeObj?.ad || !storeObj?.ct || !storeObj?.st || !storeObj?.zp) {
        return;
      }

      let _preferredStore = getPreferredStoreDetails()
        ? JSON.parse(getPreferredStoreDetails())
        : {};

      const formattedZip = storeObj?.zp ? storeObj.zp.split("-")[0] : "";

      const updatedStoreDetails = {
        address: storeObj?.ad,
        city: storeObj?.ct,
        latitude: storeObj?.la,
        longitude: storeObj?.lo,
        state: storeObj?.st,
        storeService: storeObj?.ss,
        storeNumber: parseInt(storeObj?.sn),
        // TODO: remove 'number' after full roll out to cloud
        number: parseInt(storeObj?.sn),
        zip: storeObj?.zp,
        isSezzle: isSezzle(storeObj?.ss),
        isBopis: isBopis(storeObj?.ss),
        isDelivery: isDelivery(storeObj?.ss),
        lastUpdated: Date.now(),
        fullAddress: storeObj?.ct + ", " + storeObj?.st + " " + formattedZip,
      };

      _preferredStore[isUser ? "userStore" : "guestStore"] = updatedStoreDetails;

      localStorage.setItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY, JSON.stringify(_preferredStore));

      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("updateStoreEvent"));
    }

    const SPARK_CODES = {
      tokenExpired: [
        "2548a7f3-7bf4-4533-a6c1-dcbcfcdc26a5",
        "2cf51692-2bea-4ccc-ba8e-70c463a55fc9",
        "e5d248e8-7573-4719-9e5c-1d49b67134de",
        "b419e0e0-af8a-413d-8af2-b3e1f7005193",
      ]
    };

    /**
     * Refreshes tokens by calling the user state servlet with refreshCookies=true.
     * Updates globalThis.DG.sessionData and dispatches dg:sessionUpdated so all modules sync.
     */
    async function refreshTokens() {
      return fetch('/bin/dg/user?refreshCookies=true&timestamp=' + Date.now())
        .then((response) => response.json())
        .then((data) => {
          globalThis.DG = globalThis.DG || {};
          globalThis.DG.sessionData = data;
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dg:sessionUpdated', { detail: data }));
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          throw error;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Sets common API headers for store API calls using tokens from sessionData.
     */
    function setStoreApiHeaders(xhr) {
      xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
      xhr.setRequestHeader("X-DG-appToken", getToken("appToken"));
      xhr.setRequestHeader("X-DG-appSessionToken", getToken("appSessionToken"));
      xhr.setRequestHeader("X-DG-customerGuid", getToken("customerGuid"));
      xhr.setRequestHeader("X-DG-deviceUniqueId", getToken("uniqueDeviceId"));
      xhr.setRequestHeader("X-DG-partnerApiToken", getToken("partnerApiToken"));
      xhr.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + getToken("idToken"));
      if (useCloudService) {
        xhr.setRequestHeader("X-DG-CLOUD-SERVICE", useCloudService);
      }
      applyEcomRolloutHeadersToXhr(xhr);
    }

    var MYDGPLUS_ROLLOUT_FLAG_KEY = 'mydgplus_rollout';
    var VTEX_CART_FLAG_KEY = 'vTexCart';
    var ECOMM_CLOUD_HEADER = 'X-DG-ECOMM-CLOUD';

    function isMyDgPlusRolloutEnabledApicall() {
      var client = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.ldClient;
      if (!client || !globalThis.DG.ldReady) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        return client.variation(MYDGPLUS_ROLLOUT_FLAG_KEY, false) === true;
      } catch (ignored) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    function isVTexCartRolloutEnabledApicall() {
      var client = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.ldClient;
      if (!client || !globalThis.DG.ldReady) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        return client.variation(VTEX_CART_FLAG_KEY, false) === true;
      } catch (ignored) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    function isEcommCloudHeaderEnabledApicall() {
      return isMyDgPlusRolloutEnabledApicall() || isVTexCartRolloutEnabledApicall();
    }

    function applyEcomRolloutHeadersToXhr(xhr) {
      if (!isEcommCloudHeaderEnabledApicall()) {
        return;
      }
      xhr.setRequestHeader(ECOMM_CLOUD_HEADER, true);
      var accessToken = getToken('accessToken');
      if (accessToken) {
        xhr.setRequestHeader('X-AccessToken', accessToken);
      }
    }

    // Waits for the LD client to exist, not for bootstrap to complete — these
    // store XHRs are what ldStoreResolutionDone depends on, so gating them on
    // ldBootstrapPromise would deadlock first-time visitors.
    function ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(callback) {
      ldRunWhenLdReady(callback);
    }

    /**
     * Fetches store details by store number.
     * @param {number} storeNumber - the store number to fetch
     * @param {boolean} fallbackFlow - if true, writes to "userStore" key
     */
    async function getGuestStoreDetails(storeNumber, fallbackFlow = false) {
      let storeDetailsUrl = 'https://dggo.dollargeneral.com/omni/api/store/info/';
      storeDetailsUrl = storeDetailsUrl + storeNumber;

      const guestStoreDetails = async () => {
        try {
          var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open("GET", storeDetailsUrl, true);
          setStoreApiHeaders(xhr);

          xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
              const sparkCode = this.getResponseHeader("x-spark");
              if (sparkCode && SPARK_CODES.tokenExpired.includes(sparkCode)) {
                refreshTokens()
                  .then(() => guestStoreDetails())
                  .catch(() => {
                    console.error("Failed to refresh tokens.");
                  });
              } else if (this.response) {
                setStoreDetails(JSON.parse(this.response).storeinfo, fallbackFlow);
              }
            }
          };
          xhr.send();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Request failed ', error.msg);
        }
      };

      ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(guestStoreDetails);
    }

    /**
     * Searches for nearest store by lat/lng, then fetches that store's details.
     */
    async function makeCallForPreferredStore(fallbackFlow = false) {
      const inventoryUrl = 'https://dggo.dollargeneral.com/omni/api/store/search/inventory';
      const akamaiLatitudeFromCookie = getCookie('akamaiLatitude');
      const akamaiLongitudeFromCookie = getCookie('akamaiLongitude');

      let payLoad = {
        latitude: DEFAULT_LATITUDE,
        longitude: DEFAULT_LONGITUDE,
        radius: window?.DG?.aemData?.config?.inventoryCallSearchRadius ?? DEFAULT_STORE_SEARCH_RADIUS,
      };

      if (globalThis.DG.aemData.config.useAkamaiLatLng && akamaiLatitudeFromCookie && akamaiLongitudeFromCookie) {
        payLoad.latitude = parseFloat(akamaiLatitudeFromCookie);
        payLoad.longitude = parseFloat(akamaiLongitudeFromCookie);
      }

      const preferredStoreCall = async () => {
        try {
          var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open("POST", inventoryUrl, true);
          setStoreApiHeaders(xhr);

          xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
              const sparkCode = this.getResponseHeader("x-spark");
              if (sparkCode && SPARK_CODES.tokenExpired.includes(sparkCode)) {
                refreshTokens()
                  .then(() => preferredStoreCall())
                  .catch(() => {
                    console.error("Failed to refresh tokens.");
                  });
              } else if (this.response) {
                let storeList = JSON.parse(this.response).stores;
                const urlStoreNumber = getQueryParam('storeNumber');

                if (enableStoreSelectionFromURL && urlStoreNumber) {
                  getGuestStoreDetails(urlStoreNumber, fallbackFlow);
                } else if (storeList.length > 0) {
                  getGuestStoreDetails(parseInt(storeList[0].storeNumber), fallbackFlow);
                } else {
                  getGuestStoreDetails(DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER, fallbackFlow);
                }
              }
            }
          };
          xhr.send(JSON.stringify(payLoad));
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Request failed ', error.msg);
          getGuestStoreDetails(DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER, fallbackFlow);
        }
      };

      ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(preferredStoreCall);
    }

    /**
     * Sets guest preferred store from localStorage or fetches via Akamai geo.
     */
    function setGuestPreferredStore() {

      if (globalThis.DG.sessionData?.storeInfo?.sn) {
        setStoreDetails(globalThis.DG.sessionData.storeInfo, false);
        return;
      }

      let localPreferredStore =
        localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);

      if (!localPreferredStore) {
        if (globalThis.DG.aemData.config.useAkamaiLatLng) {
          makeCallForPreferredStore();
          return;
        }
      }

      const parsedStore = JSON.parse(localPreferredStore);
      const guestStore = parsedStore?.guestStore;

      if (!guestStore || !guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        if (globalThis.DG.aemData.config.useAkamaiLatLng) {
          makeCallForPreferredStore();
          return;
        }
      }

      if (guestStore && guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        return;
      }

      getGuestStoreDetails(DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER);
    }

    /**
     * Fetches preferred store for a signed-in user by store number.
     */
    async function callForPreferredUserStore(storeNumber) {
      let storeDetailsUrl = 'https://dggo.dollargeneral.com/omni/api/store/info/';
      storeDetailsUrl = storeDetailsUrl + storeNumber;

      const preferredUserStoreCall = async () => {
        try {
          var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open("GET", storeDetailsUrl, true);
          setStoreApiHeaders(xhr);

          xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
              const sparkCode = this.getResponseHeader("x-spark");
              if (sparkCode && SPARK_CODES.tokenExpired.includes(sparkCode)) {
                refreshTokens()
                  .then(() => preferredUserStoreCall())
                  .catch(() => {
                    console.error("Failed to refresh tokens.");
                  });
              } else if (this.response) {
                setStoreDetails(JSON.parse(this.response).storeinfo, true);
              }
            }
          };
          xhr.send();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Request failed ', error.msg);
        }
      };

      ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(preferredUserStoreCall);
    }

    /**
     * Fallback for signed-in user when no preferred store is found.
     * Copies guest store to userStore or fetches via geo.
     */
    function initiateUserFailFallback() {
      let localPreferredStore = localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);

      if (!localPreferredStore) {
        makeCallForPreferredStore(true);
        return;
      }

      const parsedStore = JSON.parse(localPreferredStore);
      const guestStore = parsedStore?.guestStore;

      if (!guestStore || !guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        makeCallForPreferredStore(true);
        return;
      }

      if (guestStore && guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        let _preferredStore = getPreferredStoreDetails()
          ? JSON.parse(getPreferredStoreDetails())
          : {};

        _preferredStore["userStore"] = guestStore;

        localStorage.setItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY, JSON.stringify(_preferredStore));

        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("updateStoreEvent"));
        console.log("Store data updated, event dispatched");
      }
    }

    /**
     * Gets the signed-in user's preferred store from session + localStorage.
     * LD identify uses the same sources; Gigya is not required on this path.
     */
    function getUserStore() {
      var sessionData = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData;
      ldSeedContextFromSessionAndLocal(sessionData);

      let localPreferredStore = JSON.parse(
        localStorage?.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY) || "null"
      );

      const urlStoreNumber = getQueryParam('storeNumber');

      if (localPreferredStore?.userStore?.storeNumber
          && localPreferredStore.userStore.storeNumber == urlStoreNumber) {
        ldIdentifyMerged({
          storeId: String(localPreferredStore.userStore.storeNumber),
        });
        runWhenGigyaReady(function () {
          if (!window.gigya || !window.gigya.accounts || !window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo) {
            ldApplyGigyaPreferredStoreForLdWithFallbacks(null, globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            return;
          }
          window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo({
            include: 'profile,data,loginIDs',
            callback: function (response) {
              ldRefreshLdCachesFromGigyaAccountInfoResponse(response);
              ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            },
          });
        });
        return;
      }

      runWhenGigyaReady(function () {
        if (!window.gigya || !window.gigya.accounts || !window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo) {
          initiateUserFailFallback();
          ldApplyGigyaPreferredStoreForLdWithFallbacks(null, globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
          ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
          return;
        }
        window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo({
          include: 'profile,data,loginIDs',
          callback: function (response) {
            if (response.errorCode !== 0) {
              initiateUserFailFallback();
              ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
              return;
            }

            const prefFromResponse = response.data?.preferences?.preferredStore
              ? parseInt(response.data.preferences.preferredStore, 10)
              : null;
            const localUserStoreNumber = localPreferredStore?.userStore?.storeNumber ?? null;

            var ldStore = ldReadStoreIdFromSession(globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            if (ldStore == null) {
              ldStore = ldReadStoreIdFromLocalPreferred();
            }

            if (enableStoreSelectionFromURL && urlStoreNumber
                && urlStoreNumber !== prefFromResponse
                && urlStoreNumber !== localUserStoreNumber) {
              ldStore = urlStoreNumber;
              callForPreferredUserStore(urlStoreNumber);
            } else if (prefFromResponse) {
              ldStore = prefFromResponse;
              callForPreferredUserStore(prefFromResponse);
            } else {
              initiateUserFailFallback();
              if (ldStore == null) {
                ldStore = ldReadStoreIdFromSession(globalThis.DG.sessionData) || ldReadStoreIdFromLocalPreferred();
              }
            }

            var ldPatch = {};
            if (ldStore != null && !isNaN(ldStore)) {
              ldPatch.storeId = String(ldStore);
            }
            ldRefreshLdCachesFromGigyaAccountInfoResponse(response);
            ldIdentifyMerged(ldPatch);
          },
        });
      });
    }

    function clearAllCookies() {
      const cookiesList = document.cookie.split(';');
      cookiesList.forEach((cookie) => {
        const key = cookie.split('=');
        if (key[0].trim() !== 'uniqueDeviceId') {
          document.cookie = key[0] + "=; expires=" + new Date().toUTCString() + "; path=/;";
        }
      });
    }

    function logOut(data) {
      runWhenGigyaReady(() => {
        window.gigya?.accounts?.logout({
          callback: async () => {
            await fetch('/bin/omni/logout');
            document.cookie = 'kmsi==;max-age=0;path=/';
            globalThis.DG?.storage?.resetStorage();
            if (globalThis.DG) {
              ldGigyaCtxClear();
            }
            clearAllCookies();
            const viewedOnFirstCashbackClipValue = localStorage.getItem('viewedOnFirstCashbackClip');
            localStorage.clear();
            sessionStorage.clear();
            localStorage.setItem('reloadCustomerData', 'true');
            if (viewedOnFirstCashbackClipValue !== null) {
              localStorage.setItem('viewedOnFirstCashbackClip', viewedOnFirstCashbackClipValue);
            }
            if (window.claripDNSSCustomerData) {
              window.claripDNSSCustomerData = {};
            }
            window.location.href = data?.signInUrl || '/';
          },
        });
      });
    }

    /**
     * Fetches the session, retrying brief failures (network error, 5xx, unparseable body)
     * so a signed-in visitor isn't identified to LD as a guest after a transient blip.
     * 4xx bodies (e.g. 401 "Session expired") are real answers the page handles, so they pass through.
     */
    async function fetchSessionWithRetry(buildUrl) {
      var retryDelaysMs = [300, 800];
      for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
        try {
          const resp = await fetch(buildUrl());
          if (resp.status >= 500) {
            throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
          }
          return await resp.json();
        } catch (error) {
          if (attempt >= retryDelaysMs.length) {
            throw error;
          }
          console.warn('[LD] session fetch failed, retrying:', error && error.message);
          await new Promise(function (resolve) {
            setTimeout(resolve, retryDelaysMs[attempt]);
          });
        }
      }
    }

    /**
     * Single entry point: call /bin/dg/user for tokens, then run store logic.
     *
     * 1. Fetch tokens from servlet → set globalThis.DG.sessionData → dispatch event
     * 2. If authenticated → getUserStore() (Gigya compare + store fetch)
     * 3. If guest → setGuestPreferredStore() (localStorage or Akamai geo fetch)
     */
    (async () => {
      try {
        const urlStoreNumber = getQueryParam('storeNumber') ;
        const data = await fetchSessionWithRetry(function () {
          return urlStoreNumber
            ? '/bin/dg/user?storeNumber=' + urlStoreNumber + '&timestamp=' + Date.now()
            : '/bin/dg/user?timestamp=' + Date.now();
        });

        globalThis.DG = globalThis.DG || {};
        var prevGuid =
          globalThis.DG.sessionData && globalThis.DG.sessionData.customerGuid != null
            ? String(globalThis.DG.sessionData.customerGuid).trim()
            : '';
        var nextGuid =
          data && data.customerGuid != null ? String(data.customerGuid).trim() : '';
        if (data.sessionType !== 'authenticated' || nextGuid !== prevGuid) {
          ldGigyaCtxClear();
        }
        globalThis.DG.sessionData = data;
        ldSeedContextFromSessionAndLocal(data);
        ldTryBootstrapIdentify();
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dg:sessionUpdated', { detail: data }));

        if (data.sessionType === 'authenticated') {
          getUserStore();
        } else {
          setGuestPreferredStore();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to initialize session', error);
        ldBootstrapGuestFallback('session-fetch-failed');
      }
    })();

  </script>

        const TARGET_SELECTOR = '.splide';

    gap: 8,

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {

      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        splide.refresh();
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  observer.observe(el);
}

function initAll() {
  document.querySelectorAll(TARGET_SELECTOR).forEach((el) => {
    if (el.dataset.mounted) return;
    el.dataset.mounted = 'true';
    mountSplide(el);
  });
}

function loadScript(src) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (window.Splide) return resolve();

    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = src;
    script.onload = resolve;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
}

}

    function getSlides(carousel) {
        return Array.from(
            carousel.querySelectorAll(
                '.splide__slide:not(.splide__slide--clone)'
            )
        );
    }

    function getActiveSlideIndex(slides) {
        return slides.findIndex((slide) =>
            slide.classList.contains('is-active')
        );
    }

    function isButtonDisabled(button) {
        return (
            button.disabled ||
            button.hasAttribute('disabled') ||
            button.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'
        );
    }

    function resetToFirstSlide(prevButton, steps, done) {
        let remainingSteps = steps;

        function goPrevious() {
            if (remainingSteps <= 0) {
                done();
                return;
            }

            prevButton.click();
            remainingSteps--;

            window.setTimeout(goPrevious, 120);
        }

        goPrevious();
    }

    function startCarouselAutoplay(carousel) {
        if (!carousel.hasAttribute('data-cmp-autoplay')) {
            return;
        }

        const delay = getValidDelay(carousel);

        // No valid data-cmp-delay value means no autoplay
        if (!delay) {
            return;
        }

        const nextButton = carousel.querySelector('.splide__arrow--next');
        const prevButton = carousel.querySelector('.splide__arrow--prev');

        if (!nextButton || !prevButton) {
            return;
        }

        let isResetting = false;
        let isHovered = false;

        carousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            isHovered = true;
        });

        carousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            isHovered = false;
        });

        window.setInterval(() => {
            // Pause autoplay while hovering
            if (isHovered || isResetting) {
                return;
            }

            const slides = getSlides(carousel);

            if (!slides.length) {
                return;
            }

            let activeIndex = getActiveSlideIndex(slides);

            if (activeIndex === -1) {
                activeIndex = 0;
            }

            const lastIndex = slides.length - 1;

            const isLastSlide =
                activeIndex === lastIndex || isButtonDisabled(nextButton);

            if (isLastSlide) {
                isResetting = true;

                resetToFirstSlide(prevButton, activeIndex, () => {
                    isResetting = false;
                });

                return;
            }

            nextButton.click();
        }, delay);
    }

    function initCarouselAutoplay() {
        document
            .querySelectorAll('.cmp-carousel[data-cmp-autoplay]')
            .forEach(startCarouselAutoplay);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initCarouselAutoplay);
    } else {
        initCarouselAutoplay();
    }
})();
    </script>

          <div data-how-delivery-works-content="<p style="text-align: left;"><b>Scheduling</b><br>
<br>
To ensure we deliver your order at a time that is best for your schedule, you will be asked to select your desired delivery time:</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><b>ASAP:&nbsp;</b>Arrives within 1 hour of placing order, additional fee applies</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><b>Later:&nbsp;</b>Schedule for the same day or next day</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><br>
<b>Fees</b><br>
<br>
Delivery fees are not adjustable should the order size change due to out of stocks, substitutions, or refunds and returns.<br>
<br>
<b>Delivering</b><br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Upon order confirmation, a shopper is assigned to align with your selected delivery time. You will receive a series of texts and/or emails to keep you posted on your order progress and delivery arrival.<br>
<br>
<b>Cancelling</b><br>
<br>
After placing your order, you will have up until a shopper is assigned to cancel your order. Your order details page, accessible from your confirmation email or your account for signed in customers, will have a “Cancel order” button if this option is still available. You will not be able to modify your order after placement.<br>
<br>
<b>Substitutions</b><br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Unfortunately, an item you have ordered may occasionally become unavailable, but many products have an eligible alternative that we can substitute.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">All items ordered for delivery will default to “Allow Substitutions.” Should there be an item you do not wish to be substituted, just uncheck the Allow Substitutions box next to that item when prompted.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">You will need to provide a valid mobile number and email so our delivery team can advise you of available substitute items when your order is processed in store.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Substituted items may not be eligible for discounts and offers that were applicable to the original items in your DG Delivery order. You will be charged the retail price of the substituted item and not the retail price of the original item in your DG Delivery order.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><b>Returns &amp; Refunds</b><br>
<br>
If we did not get something right with your delivered order, we are here to help.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">We offer two options to process your refund.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">1. Self-Service: Tap the “Need help with your order?” link on your order details page to process a self-service refund. Restrictions and limitations apply.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">2. Customer Care: Contact our Customer Care team directly.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Visit our Help Center on DG.com or in the DG App to learn more about our complete Return Policy.</p>
" id="how-delivery-works-content">
          </div>
          <div data-how-delivery-works-buttontext="OK" id="how-delivery-works-buttontext"></div>
     </div>

          <div data-shipping-and-return-policy-content="<p><b>Shipping</b><br>
Items ship 1-2 business days after receiving your order. Choose between 3 different FedEx shipping service levels (costs will vary).</p>
<p>FedEx Ground (Arrives in 5-10 business days)<br>
FedEx 2-Day (Arrives 2-4 business days)<br>
FedEx Overnight (Arrives 1-3 business days)</p>
<p>Shipping is offered to the 48 contiguous United States, Alaska, and Hawaii.</p>
<p><b>Cancellations</b><br>
You may cancel your order within 30 minutes of placing it. Your order details page, accessible from your confirmation email or your account for signed in customers, will have a “Cancel order” button if this option is still available.</p>
<p><b>Returns</b><br>
Unused items can be returned within 30 days of purchase. We do not accept returns of food or hazmat items. Store locations are unable to accept returned products that were shipped to you.</p>
<p>Return postage will be the responsibility of the customer. Please visit our&nbsp;<a href="http://localhost:4502/content/dollargeneral/en/help-center.html?t=shipping">Help Center</a>&nbsp;for further return instructions.</p>
<p><b>Refunds</b><br>
You can expect a refund in the same form of payment originally used for purchase or in the form of a Dollar General gift card. Your refund will include the cost of the item, plus any applicable sales tax. Shipping charges are non-refundable.</p>
<p>Please visit our&nbsp;<a href="http://localhost:4502/content/dollargeneral/en/help-center.html?t=shipping">Help Center</a>&nbsp;to contact our customer care team.</p>
" id="shipping-and-return-policy-content"></div>

  <script type="text/javascript">

    globalThis.DG = globalThis.DG || {};
    (function ldSetupBootstrap() {
      if (globalThis.DG.ldBootstrapPromise) {
        return;
      }
      globalThis.DG.ldStoreResolutionDone = false;
      var bootstrapDone = false;
      globalThis.DG.ldBootstrapPromise = new Promise(function (resolve) {
        // Last-resort only: LD ready + identify should complete via explicit paths below.
        var hangGuardId = setTimeout(function () {
          if (!bootstrapDone) {
            console.warn('[LD] bootstrap hang guard — forcing completion after 10s');
            ldCompleteBootstrap();
          }
        }, 10000);
        globalThis.DG.__ldCompleteBootstrap = function () {
          if (bootstrapDone) {
            return;
          }
          bootstrapDone = true;
          clearTimeout(hangGuardId);
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dg:ldBootstrapComplete'));
          resolve();
        };
      });
    })();

    function ldCompleteBootstrap() {
      if (globalThis.DG && typeof globalThis.DG.__ldCompleteBootstrap === 'function') {
        globalThis.DG.__ldCompleteBootstrap();
      }
    }

    function ldAbortBootstrap(reason) {
      console.warn('[LD] bootstrap aborted:', reason);
      ldCompleteBootstrap();
    }

    function ldRunWhenLdReady(callback) {
      if (globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.ldReady) {
        callback();
        return;
      }
      globalThis.addEventListener('dg:ldReady', function () {
        callback();
      }, { once: true });
    }

    /**
     * When /bin/dg/user fails, still attempt a guest identify so flag consumers can proceed.
     */
    function ldBootstrapGuestFallback(reason) {
      console.warn('[LD] session unavailable — guest identify fallback:', reason);
      if (!globalThis.DG || !globalThis.DG.ldClient) {
        ldAbortBootstrap(reason || 'session-failed-no-ld-client');
        return;
      }
      ldRunWhenLdReady(function () {
        var deviceId = getCookie('uniqueDeviceId');
        var sessionStub = { sessionType: 'guest' };
        if (deviceId) {
          sessionStub.uniqueDeviceId = deviceId;
        }
        ldIdentifyUser(sessionStub);
      });
    }

    function ldTryBootstrapIdentify() {
      if (!globalThis.DG || !globalThis.DG.ldReady || !globalThis.DG.sessionData) {
        return;
      }
      ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG.sessionData);
    }

    /**
     * Initializes LaunchDarkly with an anonymous user context. Runs synchronously
     * before the /bin/dg/user fetch so the SDK starts connecting while waiting
     * for session data. Client key comes from OSGi (LAUNCHDARKLY_CLIENT_KEY / omni ldClientKey).
     * ldIdentifyUser context must stay in sync with ui.frontend launchDarkly.ts buildLdUserContext.
     */
    function initLaunchDarkly() {
      if (globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.ldClient) {
        if (globalThis.DG.ldReady) {
          ldTryBootstrapIdentify();
        }
        return;
      }
      if (typeof LDClient === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[LD] SDK not loaded — feature flags unavailable');
        ldAbortBootstrap('sdk-not-loaded');
        return;
      }
      try {
        var clientKey = '696aa86c85757f09fa4161c0';
        if (!clientKey) {
          console.warn('[LD] ldClientKey not configured in OSGi (LAUNCHDARKLY_CLIENT_KEY env var)');
          ldAbortBootstrap('missing-client-key');
          return;
        }
        var initContext = { kind: 'user', key: 'anonymous', anonymous: true };
        var initVisitorId = ldReadUniqueDeviceIdCookie();
        if (initVisitorId) {
          initContext.visitorId = initVisitorId;
        }
        var client = LDClient.initialize(
          clientKey,
          initContext,
          // evaluationReasons exposes reason.inExperiment for A/B experiments
          // (e.g. ai-search). Inert for boolean gate flags — they ignore reason.
          { streaming: true, evaluationReasons: true }
        );
        globalThis.DG = globalThis.DG || {};
        globalThis.DG.ldClient = client;
        client.on('ready', function () {
          globalThis.DG.ldReady = true;
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dg:ldReady', { detail: client }));
          ldTryBootstrapIdentify();
        });
        client.on('failed', function (err) {
          console.error('[LD] client failed', err);
          ldAbortBootstrap('client-failed');
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[LD] Initialization failed', e);
        ldAbortBootstrap('init-exception');
      }
    }

    function ldLooksLikeEmail(s) {
      return typeof s === 'string' && s.indexOf('@') !== -1;
    }

    var LD_GIGYA_CTX_KEY = '__dgLdGigyaContext';
    function ldGigyaCtx() {
      var root = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : window;
      if (!root[LD_GIGYA_CTX_KEY] || typeof root[LD_GIGYA_CTX_KEY] !== 'object') {
        root[LD_GIGYA_CTX_KEY] = {};
      }
      return root[LD_GIGYA_CTX_KEY];
    }
    function ldGigyaCtxClear() {
      var c = ldGigyaCtx();
      delete c.email;
      delete c.storeId;
      delete c.mydgMembershipStatus;
      delete c.mydgMembershipValidUntil;
      if (globalThis.DG) {
        delete globalThis.DG.ldIdentifyKey;
        delete globalThis.DG.ldGigyaContextReady;
      }
    }

    function ldIsAuthenticatedSession() {
      var session = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData;
      return Boolean(session && session.sessionType === 'authenticated');
    }

    /**
     * Seeds LD targeting caches from /bin/dg/user session and preferredStoreData
     * localStorage — no Gigya getAccountInfo required for bootstrap.
     */
    function ldSeedContextFromSessionAndLocal(sessionData) {
      if (!sessionData) {
        return;
      }
      var sessionEmail = sessionData.email;
      if (typeof sessionEmail === 'string' && sessionEmail.trim() && ldLooksLikeEmail(sessionEmail)) {
        ldSetGigyaEmailForLdFromProfile(sessionEmail);
      }
      ldApplyGigyaPreferredStoreForLdWithFallbacks(null, sessionData);
    }

    /**
     * Bootstrap only completes once storeId is resolved into the LD context
     * (ldStoreResolutionDone), not just on "an identify happened" — otherwise
     * store-targeted flags (ai-search) evaluate against no store.
     */
    function ldShouldCompleteBootstrap() {
      if (!ldIsAuthenticatedSession()) {
        return Boolean(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.ldStoreResolutionDone);
      }
      return Boolean(
        globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData && globalThis.DG.ldStoreResolutionDone
      );
    }

    function ldMaybeCompleteBootstrap() {
      if (ldShouldCompleteBootstrap()) {
        ldCompleteBootstrap();
      }
    }

    function ldCtxKey(context) {
      if (!context) {
        return '';
      }
      return [
        context.kind || '',
        context.key || '',
        context.anonymous === true,
        context.email || '',
        context.mydgplus === true,
        context.storeId != null ? context.storeId : '',
        context.state || '',
        context.campaignCode || '',
        context.visitorId || ''
      ].join('|');
    }

    function ldSetGigyaEmailForLdFromProfile(raw) {
      var c = ldGigyaCtx();
      var s = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : '';
      if (s && ldLooksLikeEmail(s)) {
        c.email = s.toLowerCase();
      } else {
        delete c.email;
      }
    }

    function ldSetGigyaStoreIdForLdFromProfile(raw) {
      var c = ldGigyaCtx();
      var n;
      if (typeof raw === 'number' && !isNaN(raw)) {
        n = raw;
      } else {
        var rawAsString = '';
        if (raw != null) {
          rawAsString = String(raw);
        }
        n = parseInt(rawAsString.trim(), 10);
      }
      if (raw != null && String(raw).trim() !== '' && !isNaN(n) && n > 0) {
        c.storeId = String(n);
      } else {
        delete c.storeId;
      }
    }

    function ldSetGigyaMydgEnrollmentForLdFromProfile(response) {
      var c = ldGigyaCtx();
      var mydg = response && response.data && response.data.enrollments && response.data.enrollments.myDGplus;
      if (!mydg || typeof mydg !== 'object') {
        delete c.mydgMembershipStatus;
        delete c.mydgMembershipValidUntil;
        return;
      }
      var status = typeof mydg.membershipStatus === 'string' ? mydg.membershipStatus.trim() : '';
      if (status) {
        c.mydgMembershipStatus = status;
      } else {
        delete c.mydgMembershipStatus;
      }
      var validUntil = typeof mydg.membershipValidUntil === 'string' ? mydg.membershipValidUntil.trim() : '';
      if (validUntil) {
        c.mydgMembershipValidUntil = validUntil;
      } else {
        delete c.mydgMembershipValidUntil;
      }
    }

    function ldReadStoreIdFromSession(sessionData) {
      if (!sessionData) return null;
      if (sessionData.storeId != null && String(sessionData.storeId).trim() !== '') {
        var nTop = parseInt(String(sessionData.storeId).trim(), 10);
        return isNaN(nTop) ? null : nTop;
      }
      var info = sessionData.storeInfo;
      if (info && info.sn != null && String(info.sn).trim() !== '') {
        var nSn = parseInt(String(info.sn), 10);
        return isNaN(nSn) ? null : nSn;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function ldReadStoreIdFromLocalPreferred() {
      var preferredStore = ldReadPreferredStoreDataFromLocalStorage();
      if (!preferredStore) {
        return null;
      }
      var userStoreNumber = ldParseStoreNumber(
        preferredStore.userStore && preferredStore.userStore.storeNumber
      );
      if (userStoreNumber != null) {
        return userStoreNumber;
      }
      return ldParseStoreNumber(
        preferredStore.guestStore && preferredStore.guestStore.storeNumber
      );
    }

    function ldReadUserStoreNumberFromLocalPreferred() {
      var preferredStore = ldReadPreferredStoreDataFromLocalStorage();
      if (!preferredStore) {
        return null;
      }
      return ldParseStoreNumber(
        preferredStore.userStore && preferredStore.userStore.storeNumber
      );
    }

    function ldTrimString(value) {
      if (typeof value !== 'string') {
        return '';
      }
      var trimmed = value.trim();
      return trimmed || '';
    }

    function ldReadCampaignCodeFromUrl() {
      try {
        return ldTrimString(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('campaignCode'));
      } catch (ignored) {
        return '';
      }
    }

    function ldReadPreferredStoreRowForLd(isAuthenticated) {
      var preferredStore = ldReadPreferredStoreDataFromLocalStorage();
      if (!preferredStore) {
        return null;
      }

    /**
     * Store service enum in binary for "sezzle" is {@code 1000 0000 0000 0000 0000}.
     */
    const SEZZLE_BIT_MASK_VALUE = 524288;

    /**
     * Store service enum in binary for "bopis" is {@code 0000 0000 0000 0000 1000}.
     */
    const BOPIS_BIT_MASK_VALUE = 8;

    /**
     * Store service enum in binary for "delivery" is {@code 0000 0000 0001 0000 0000}.
     */
    const DELIVERY_BIT_MASK_VALUE = 256;

    /**
     * The key name for the object stored in localStorage for user store and guest store data.
     */
    const PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY = "preferredStoreData";

    function ldParseStoreNumber(storeNumber) {

    function ldReadPreferredStoreDataFromLocalStorage() {
      try {
        var storedJson = localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);
        if (!storedJson) {

        return JSON.parse(storedJson);
      } catch (ignored) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    const DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER = 1014;
    const DEFAULT_STORE_SEARCH_RADIUS = 10;
    const DEFAULT_LATITUDE = 0;
    const DEFAULT_LONGITUDE = 0;

    const useCloudService = window.__FEATURE_FLAGS__?.useCloudServicesHeader;
    const enableStoreSelectionFromURL = window.__FEATURE_FLAGS__?.enableStoreSelectionFromURL;

    const isSezzle = (storeService) =>
      (storeService & SEZZLE_BIT_MASK_VALUE) === SEZZLE_BIT_MASK_VALUE;
    const isBopis = (storeService) =>
      (storeService & BOPIS_BIT_MASK_VALUE) === BOPIS_BIT_MASK_VALUE;
    const isDelivery = (storeService) =>
      (storeService & DELIVERY_BIT_MASK_VALUE) === DELIVERY_BIT_MASK_VALUE;

    function getPreferredStoreDetails() {
      return localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);

    /**
     * Reads a token value from the session data populated by /bin/dg/user.

    function getCookie(cname) {
      let name = cname + "=";
      let decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
      let ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
      for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
        let c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
          c = c.substring(1);
        }
        if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
          return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
        }
      }
      return "";
    }

    /**

        callback();
        return;
      }

      const previousReadyHandler = window.onGigyaServiceReady;
      window.onGigyaServiceReady = (...args) => {
        if (typeof previousReadyHandler === 'function') {
          previousReadyHandler(...args);
        }
        callback();
      };

    function getQueryParam(param) {

    /**
     * Writes store details into localStorage.
     * Store API returns abbreviated keys (sn, ad, ct, st, zp, la, lo, ss).
     */
    function setStoreDetails(storeObj, isUser) {
      if (!storeObj?.sn || !storeObj?.ad || !storeObj?.ct || !storeObj?.st || !storeObj?.zp) {
        return;
      }

      let _preferredStore = getPreferredStoreDetails()
        ? JSON.parse(getPreferredStoreDetails())
        : {};

      const formattedZip = storeObj?.zp ? storeObj.zp.split("-")[0] : "";

      const updatedStoreDetails = {
        address: storeObj?.ad,
        city: storeObj?.ct,
        latitude: storeObj?.la,
        longitude: storeObj?.lo,
        state: storeObj?.st,
        storeService: storeObj?.ss,
        storeNumber: parseInt(storeObj?.sn),
        // TODO: remove 'number' after full roll out to cloud
        number: parseInt(storeObj?.sn),
        zip: storeObj?.zp,
        isSezzle: isSezzle(storeObj?.ss),
        isBopis: isBopis(storeObj?.ss),
        isDelivery: isDelivery(storeObj?.ss),
        lastUpdated: Date.now(),
        fullAddress: storeObj?.ct + ", " + storeObj?.st + " " + formattedZip,
      };

      _preferredStore[isUser ? "userStore" : "guestStore"] = updatedStoreDetails;

      localStorage.setItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY, JSON.stringify(_preferredStore));

      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("updateStoreEvent"));
    }

    const SPARK_CODES = {

        "2cf51692-2bea-4ccc-ba8e-70c463a55fc9",
        "e5d248e8-7573-4719-9e5c-1d49b67134de",

    /**

      xhr.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + getToken("idToken"));

    /**
     * Fetches store details by store number.
     * @param {number} storeNumber - the store number to fetch
     * @param {boolean} fallbackFlow - if true, writes to "userStore" key
     */
    async function getGuestStoreDetails(storeNumber, fallbackFlow = false) {
      let storeDetailsUrl = 'https://dggo.dollargeneral.com/omni/api/store/info/';
      storeDetailsUrl = storeDetailsUrl + storeNumber;

      const guestStoreDetails = async () => {
        try {
          var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open("GET", storeDetailsUrl, true);
          setStoreApiHeaders(xhr);

          xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
              const sparkCode = this.getResponseHeader("x-spark");
              if (sparkCode && SPARK_CODES.tokenExpired.includes(sparkCode)) {
                refreshTokens()
                  .then(() => guestStoreDetails())
                  .catch(() => {
                    console.error("Failed to refresh tokens.");
                  });
              } else if (this.response) {
                setStoreDetails(JSON.parse(this.response).storeinfo, fallbackFlow);
              }
            }
          };
          xhr.send();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Request failed ', error.msg);
        }
      };

      ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(guestStoreDetails);
    }

    /**
     * Searches for nearest store by lat/lng, then fetches that store's details.
     */
    async function makeCallForPreferredStore(fallbackFlow = false) {
      const inventoryUrl = 'https://dggo.dollargeneral.com/omni/api/store/search/inventory';
      const akamaiLatitudeFromCookie = getCookie('akamaiLatitude');
      const akamaiLongitudeFromCookie = getCookie('akamaiLongitude');

      let payLoad = {
        latitude: DEFAULT_LATITUDE,
        longitude: DEFAULT_LONGITUDE,
        radius: window?.DG?.aemData?.config?.inventoryCallSearchRadius ?? DEFAULT_STORE_SEARCH_RADIUS,
      };

      if (globalThis.DG.aemData.config.useAkamaiLatLng && akamaiLatitudeFromCookie && akamaiLongitudeFromCookie) {
        payLoad.latitude = parseFloat(akamaiLatitudeFromCookie);
        payLoad.longitude = parseFloat(akamaiLongitudeFromCookie);
      }

      const preferredStoreCall = async () => {
        try {
          var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open("POST", inventoryUrl, true);
          setStoreApiHeaders(xhr);

          xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
              const sparkCode = this.getResponseHeader("x-spark");
              if (sparkCode && SPARK_CODES.tokenExpired.includes(sparkCode)) {
                refreshTokens()
                  .then(() => preferredStoreCall())
                  .catch(() => {
                    console.error("Failed to refresh tokens.");
                  });
              } else if (this.response) {
                let storeList = JSON.parse(this.response).stores;
                const urlStoreNumber = getQueryParam('storeNumber');

                if (enableStoreSelectionFromURL && urlStoreNumber) {
                  getGuestStoreDetails(urlStoreNumber, fallbackFlow);
                } else if (storeList.length > 0) {
                  getGuestStoreDetails(parseInt(storeList[0].storeNumber), fallbackFlow);
                } else {
                  getGuestStoreDetails(DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER, fallbackFlow);
                }
              }
            }
          };
          xhr.send(JSON.stringify(payLoad));
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Request failed ', error.msg);
          getGuestStoreDetails(DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER, fallbackFlow);
        }
      };

      ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(preferredStoreCall);
    }

    /**
     * Sets guest preferred store from localStorage or fetches via Akamai geo.
     */
    function setGuestPreferredStore() {

      if (globalThis.DG.sessionData?.storeInfo?.sn) {
        setStoreDetails(globalThis.DG.sessionData.storeInfo, false);
        return;
      }

      let localPreferredStore =
        localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);

      if (!localPreferredStore) {
        if (globalThis.DG.aemData.config.useAkamaiLatLng) {
          makeCallForPreferredStore();
          return;
        }
      }

      const parsedStore = JSON.parse(localPreferredStore);
      const guestStore = parsedStore?.guestStore;

      if (!guestStore || !guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        if (globalThis.DG.aemData.config.useAkamaiLatLng) {
          makeCallForPreferredStore();
          return;
        }
      }

      if (guestStore && guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        return;
      }

      getGuestStoreDetails(DEFAULT_STORE_NUMBER);
    }

    /**
     * Fetches preferred store for a signed-in user by store number.
     */
    async function callForPreferredUserStore(storeNumber) {
      let storeDetailsUrl = 'https://dggo.dollargeneral.com/omni/api/store/info/';
      storeDetailsUrl = storeDetailsUrl + storeNumber;

      const preferredUserStoreCall = async () => {
        try {
          var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open("GET", storeDetailsUrl, true);
          setStoreApiHeaders(xhr);

          xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (this.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE && this.status === 200) {
              const sparkCode = this.getResponseHeader("x-spark");
              if (sparkCode && SPARK_CODES.tokenExpired.includes(sparkCode)) {
                refreshTokens()
                  .then(() => preferredUserStoreCall())
                  .catch(() => {
                    console.error("Failed to refresh tokens.");
                  });
              } else if (this.response) {
                setStoreDetails(JSON.parse(this.response).storeinfo, true);
              }
            }
          };
          xhr.send();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Request failed ', error.msg);
        }
      };

      ldRunWhenOmniApiReady(preferredUserStoreCall);
    }

    /**
     * Fallback for signed-in user when no preferred store is found.
     * Copies guest store to userStore or fetches via geo.
     */
    function initiateUserFailFallback() {
      let localPreferredStore = localStorage.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY);

      if (!localPreferredStore) {
        makeCallForPreferredStore(true);
        return;
      }

      const parsedStore = JSON.parse(localPreferredStore);
      const guestStore = parsedStore?.guestStore;

      if (!guestStore || !guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        makeCallForPreferredStore(true);
        return;
      }

      if (guestStore && guestStore?.storeNumber) {
        let _preferredStore = getPreferredStoreDetails()
          ? JSON.parse(getPreferredStoreDetails())
          : {};

        _preferredStore["userStore"] = guestStore;

        localStorage.setItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY, JSON.stringify(_preferredStore));

        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("updateStoreEvent"));
        console.log("Store data updated, event dispatched");
      }
    }

    /**
     * Gets the signed-in user's preferred store from session + localStorage.
     * LD identify uses the same sources; Gigya is not required on this path.
     */
    function getUserStore() {
      var sessionData = globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData;
      ldSeedContextFromSessionAndLocal(sessionData);

      let localPreferredStore = JSON.parse(
        localStorage?.getItem(PREFERRED_STORE_DATA_KEY) || "null"
      );

      const urlStoreNumber = getQueryParam('storeNumber');

      if (localPreferredStore?.userStore?.storeNumber
          && localPreferredStore.userStore.storeNumber == urlStoreNumber) {
        ldIdentifyMerged({
          storeId: String(localPreferredStore.userStore.storeNumber),
        });
        runWhenGigyaReady(function () {
          if (!window.gigya || !window.gigya.accounts || !window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo) {
            ldApplyGigyaPreferredStoreForLdWithFallbacks(null, globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            return;
          }
          window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo({
            include: 'profile,data,loginIDs',
            callback: function (response) {
              ldRefreshLdCachesFromGigyaAccountInfoResponse(response);
              ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            },
          });
        });
        return;
      }

      runWhenGigyaReady(function () {
        if (!window.gigya || !window.gigya.accounts || !window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo) {
          initiateUserFailFallback();
          ldApplyGigyaPreferredStoreForLdWithFallbacks(null, globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
          ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
          return;
        }
        window.gigya.accounts.getAccountInfo({
          include: 'profile,data,loginIDs',
          callback: function (response) {
            if (response.errorCode !== 0) {
              initiateUserFailFallback();
              ldIdentifyUser(globalThis.DG && globalThis.DG.sessionData);
              return;
            }

            const prefFromResponse = response.data?.preferences?.preferredStore
              ? parseInt(response.data.preferences.preferredStore, 10)
              : null;
            const localUserStoreNumber = localPreferredStore?.userStore?.storeNumber ?? null;

            var ldStore = ldReadStoreIdFromSession(globalThis.DG.sessionData);
            if (ldStore == null) {
              ldStore = ldReadStoreIdFromLocalPreferred();
            }

            if (enableStoreSelectionFromURL && urlStoreNumber
                && urlStoreNumber !== prefFromResponse
                && urlStoreNumber !== localUserStoreNumber) {
              ldStore = urlStoreNumber;
              callForPreferredUserStore(urlStoreNumber);
            } else if (prefFromResponse) {
              ldStore = prefFromResponse;
              callForPreferredUserStore(prefFromResponse);
            } else {
              initiateUserFailFallback();
              if (ldStore == null) {
                ldStore = ldReadStoreIdFromSession(globalThis.DG.sessionData) || ldReadStoreIdFromLocalPreferred();
              }
            }

            var ldPatch = {};
            if (ldStore != null && !isNaN(ldStore)) {
              ldPatch.storeId = String(ldStore);
            }
            ldRefreshLdCachesFromGigyaAccountInfoResponse(response);
            ldIdentifyMerged(ldPatch);
          },
        });
      });
    }

    function clearAllCookies() {
      const cookiesList = document.cookie.split(';');
      cookiesList.forEach((cookie) => {
        const key = cookie.split('=');
        if (key[0].trim() !== 'uniqueDeviceId') {
          document.cookie = key[0] + "=; expires=" + new Date().toUTCString() + "; path=/;";
        }
      });
    }

    function logOut(data) {
      runWhenGigyaReady(() => {
        window.gigya?.accounts?.logout({
          callback: async () => {
            await fetch('/bin/omni/logout');
            document.cookie = 'kmsi==;max-age=0;path=/';
            globalThis.DG?.storage?.resetStorage();
            if (globalThis.DG) {
              ldGigyaCtxClear();
            }
            clearAllCookies();
            const viewedOnFirstCashbackClipValue = localStorage.getItem('viewedOnFirstCashbackClip');
            localStorage.clear();
            sessionStorage.clear();
            localStorage.setItem('reloadCustomerData', 'true');
            if (viewedOnFirstCashbackClipValue !== null) {
              localStorage.setItem('viewedOnFirstCashbackClip', viewedOnFirstCashbackClipValue);
            }
            if (window.claripDNSSCustomerData) {
              window.claripDNSSCustomerData = {};
            }
            window.location.href = data?.signInUrl || '/';
          },
        });
      });
    }

    /**
     * Fetches the session, retrying brief failures (network error, 5xx, unparseable body)
     * so a signed-in visitor isn't identified to LD as a guest after a transient blip.
     * 4xx bodies (e.g. 401 "Session expired") are real answers the page handles, so they pass through.
     */
    async function fetchSessionWithRetry(buildUrl) {
      var retryDelaysMs = [300, 800];
      for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
        try {
          const resp = await fetch(buildUrl());
          if (resp.status >= 500) {
            throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
          }
          return await resp.json();
        } catch (error) {
          if (attempt >= retryDelaysMs.length) {
            throw error;
          }
          console.warn('[LD] session fetch failed, retrying:', error && error.message);
          await new Promise(function (resolve) {
            setTimeout(resolve, retryDelaysMs[attempt]);
          });
        }
      }
    }

    /**
     * Single entry point: call /bin/dg/user for tokens, then run store logic.
     *
     * 1. Fetch tokens from servlet → set globalThis.DG.sessionData → dispatch event
     * 2. If authenticated → getUserStore() (Gigya compare + store fetch)
     * 3. If guest → setGuestPreferredStore() (localStorage or Akamai geo fetch)
     */
    (async () => {
      try {
        const urlStoreNumber = getQueryParam('storeNumber') ;
        const data = await fetchSessionWithRetry(function () {
          return urlStoreNumber
            ? '/bin/dg/user?storeNumber=' + urlStoreNumber + '&timestamp=' + Date.now()
            : '/bin/dg/user?timestamp=' + Date.now();
        });

        globalThis.DG = globalThis.DG || {};
        var prevGuid =
          globalThis.DG.sessionData && globalThis.DG.sessionData.customerGuid != null
            ? String(globalThis.DG.sessionData.customerGuid).trim()
            : '';
        var nextGuid =
          data && data.customerGuid != null ? String(data.customerGuid).trim() : '';
        if (data.sessionType !== 'authenticated' || nextGuid !== prevGuid) {
          ldGigyaCtxClear();
        }
        globalThis.DG.sessionData = data;
        ldSeedContextFromSessionAndLocal(data);
        ldTryBootstrapIdentify();
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dg:sessionUpdated', { detail: data }));

        if (data.sessionType === 'authenticated') {
          getUserStore();
        } else {
          setGuestPreferredStore();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to initialize session', error);
        ldBootstrapGuestFallback('session-fetch-failed');
      }
    })();

  </script>

          <div data-how-delivery-works-content="<p style="text-align: left;"><b>Scheduling</b><br>
<br>
To ensure we deliver your order at a time that is best for your schedule, you will be asked to select your desired delivery time:</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><b>ASAP:&nbsp;</b>Arrives within 1 hour of placing order, additional fee applies</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><b>Later:&nbsp;</b>Schedule for the same day or next day</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><br>
<b>Fees</b><br>
<br>
Delivery fees are not adjustable should the order size change due to out of stocks, substitutions, or refunds and returns.<br>
<br>
<b>Delivering</b><br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Upon order confirmation, a shopper is assigned to align with your selected delivery time. You will receive a series of texts and/or emails to keep you posted on your order progress and delivery arrival.<br>
<br>
<b>Cancelling</b><br>
<br>
After placing your order, you will have up until a shopper is assigned to cancel your order. Your order details page, accessible from your confirmation email or your account for signed in customers, will have a “Cancel order” button if this option is still available. You will not be able to modify your order after placement.<br>
<br>
<b>Substitutions</b><br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Unfortunately, an item you have ordered may occasionally become unavailable, but many products have an eligible alternative that we can substitute.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">All items ordered for delivery will default to “Allow Substitutions.” Should there be an item you do not wish to be substituted, just uncheck the Allow Substitutions box next to that item when prompted.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">You will need to provide a valid mobile number and email so our delivery team can advise you of available substitute items when your order is processed in store.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Substituted items may not be eligible for discounts and offers that were applicable to the original items in your DG Delivery order. You will be charged the retail price of the substituted item and not the retail price of the original item in your DG Delivery order.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><b>Returns &amp; Refunds</b><br>
<br>
If we did not get something right with your delivered order, we are here to help.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">We offer two options to process your refund.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">1. Self-Service: Tap the “Need help with your order?” link on your order details page to process a self-service refund. Restrictions and limitations apply.<br>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">2. Customer Care: Contact our Customer Care team directly.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Visit our Help Center on DG.com or in the DG App to learn more about our complete Return Policy.</p>
" id="how-delivery-works-content">

          <div data-shipping-and-return-policy-content="<p><b>Shipping</b><br>
Items ship 1-2 business days after receiving your order. Choose between 3 different FedEx shipping service levels (costs will vary).</p>
<p>FedEx Ground (Arrives in 5-10 business days)<br>
FedEx 2-Day (Arrives 2-4 business days)<br>
FedEx Overnight (Arrives 1-3 business days)</p>
<p>Shipping is offered to the 48 contiguous United States, Alaska, and Hawaii.</p>
<p><b>Cancellations</b><br>
You may cancel your order within 30 minutes of placing it. Your order details page, accessible from your confirmation email or your account for signed in customers, will have a “Cancel order” button if this option is still available.</p>
<p><b>Returns</b><br>
Unused items can be returned within 30 days of purchase. We do not accept returns of food or hazmat items. Store locations are unable to accept returned products that were shipped to you.</p>
<p>Return postage will be the responsibility of the customer. Please visit our&nbsp;<a href="http://localhost:4502/content/dollargeneral/en/help-center.html?t=shipping">Help Center</a>&nbsp;for further return instructions.</p>
<p><b>Refunds</b><br>
You can expect a refund in the same form of payment originally used for purchase or in the form of a Dollar General gift card. Your refund will include the cost of the item, plus any applicable sales tax. Shipping charges are non-refundable.</p>
<p>Please visit our&nbsp;<a href="http://localhost:4502/content/dollargeneral/en/help-center.html?t=shipping">Help Center</a>&nbsp;to contact our customer care team.</p>
